title: skills(pm-dispatch, os-dev): five measured refinements to the finding admission threshold
body:
Fixes #16551

Five measured refinements to the finding admission threshold, on `origin/main` `f48f3f1b21` (BASE), head `6e31ed35bb`. Text-only diff: 16 insertions paid by 16 deletions of restated lines; every pinned file stays at its pin (SKILL.md 811 · os-dev.md 403 · core-rules.md 150 · dispatch-runbook.md 241); every new line is under the 120-byte cap; rules only, no issue numbers, no model identifiers, no narrative in the corpus. The three-class frame, the 「三类外关 not planned(不等批准…)」 line, 「定级即离标」, the native `type` lines and the English audit line are untouched.

## Item 1 — read current state before every write (SKILL.md, 发现分诊轮 block)

New lines, after 「三类内再过时前提检查,三选一:…判级只在此轮,不在立单时。」:

```text
- ⛔ 写入前对每张卡现读当前状态;任何列表快照读数一律作废。
- ⛔ 带 `pm:dispatched` / assignee / 任何 open 或 merged PR 引用的卡,一律不动。
- ⛔ `issue_write` 会替换标签集并清空未传字段:写入时必须回传 `assignees`。
```

The third line carries a platform fact and is kept as the card wrote it. `references/platform-readings.md` (not in this flight's surface) already has the labels half at its line 195 — 「`issue_write` 的 `labels` 是整组替换不是追加:同一动作内重读现值合并再写。」 — and NO line for the other half (unpassed fields are cleared; assignees must be passed back). That half is the rider for the sixth readings increment.

## Item 2 — the acceptance-notes fallback needs a named carrier

Card evidence: 6 of 6 closed cards had no carrier. One carrier per file; the card's spelling kept.

SKILL.md (seat half), after 「(c) AI 写元数据会被运行时拒收或静默丢弃的陷阱;其余进 PR `## 验收备注`,⛔ 不立卡。」 and the three boundary lines of item 3:

```text
- 判「进验收备注」前先问:哪一个 PR 会碰到这个文件?说得出具体 PR 或人 ⇒ 写进去。
- ⛔ 说不出(`.changeset/*`、无人在改的文档页、生成物、已扫完的批次)⇒ 兜底不成立。
- 仍然关,但关闭理由必须写明「承接者:无」。
```

os-dev.md (dev half), after 「它们进 PR `## 验收备注`,报告 `out_of_scope_findings` 记 `noted, not filed: …`,席位 ACCEPT 时读。」:

```text
   - 写 `noted, not filed` 前先答哪一个 PR 或人会碰到这个文件;答不出就写明「承接者:无」。
```

SKILL.md line 779 (「席位在 ACCEPT 读 PR `## 验收备注`…三类外已立的卡关 not planned。」) is unchanged: the close-reason rule beside the three classes is the one carrier in that file.

## Item 3 — three criterion boundaries, one line each, in all three carriers

SKILL.md, directly after the (c) line:

```text
- (a) 的分界是不完整 vs 错误,不是文档 vs 代码:示例照抄即失败是 (a),漏列成员不是。
- (c) 元数据 = 由写它的人以外的人存储并再作者化的键:React prop 不是,存储的视图配置是。
- 把作者引向运行时会兑现却让事情更糟的元数据的警告不在 (c) 内;记为边界,⛔ 不扩类。
```

os-dev.md, directly after its (c) line (dev register):

```text
   - (a) 分错误与不完整,不分文档与代码:示例照抄即失败是 (a),漏列成员不是。
   - (c) 元数据 = 由写它的人以外的人存储并再作者化的键:React prop 不是,存储视图配置是。
   - 把作者引向运行时会兑现却让事情更糟的元数据的警告不在 (c) 内,记为边界不扩类。
```

core-rules.md, directly after 「立卡限三类:可复现缺陷、契约违背、元数据陷阱;…」 (summary register, one line for the three facts):

```text
- 三类边界:缺陷问错不问缺、文档同判;元数据须他人再作者化;引向更糟的警告在类外。
```

The third-failure-mode fact is recorded as the boundary, not widened into class (c).

## Item 4 — one irreversibility gate (SKILL.md, before the 「每批先验三类…」 line)

```text
- 三类外不可逆或有硬时限(发版即固化、只被消费的文件、过窗不可补)⇒ 不关,报维护者。
```

Folded from the card's two-line spelling to one 120-byte line (「被消费而非编辑的文件」→「只被消费的文件」, 「窗口关闭后无法补做」→「过窗不可补」). It triggers on the thing's window only; no uncertainty trigger was added.

## Item 5 — an acceptance metric that can fail (dispatch-runbook.md, 发现分诊轮细则 block)

```text
- 阈值落地一周后随机抽 20 条 `noted, not filed`,由席位逐条重判,量出误记率并记档。
```

Placed in the runbook, not SKILL.md, because: (1) it is a parameterised seat procedure (a sample size and a delay), which SKILL.md's own routing sends to references (SKILL.md 「细则是本文其余各节与其它 references」; runbook 「本文只放细则增量:参数、模板、步骤与原文」); (2) SKILL.md's 发现分诊轮 line already points the reader to this exact block (「每批约定与积压告警见 `references/dispatch-runbook.md`」), so the procedure lands beside the batch conventions it belongs to; (3) SKILL.md already owes ten folds for items 1–4 and an eleventh would remove a principle line where the runbook fold removes a pure restatement. 「阈值」 was prefixed so the line is self-contained. Not in os-dev.md (seat procedure, not a dev rule).
